en: Hand-colored vintage view of a town square with a prominent round stone tower on the left, featuring many green-shuttered windows and vines at street level. On the right is a crenellated stone wall resembling old fortifications, with posters on a billboard near its base. In the background are multi‑story buildings and a distant tower or castle, and several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk through the square. The caption text in Italian at the top identifies the scene as a location in Trento.
